about: [O5] A tenement stairwell by real input: in by the street door, up every flight to the roof, the roof door, the roof, the fire escape down to the street (brief O5 §2.11).

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0.2, 2.5); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const P = [[0.2, -1.2]]; for (let k = 0; k < K.N; k++) P.push([-0.75, -1.9], [-0.75, -4.9], [0.85, -4.9], [0.85, -1.9]); P.push([0.85, -1.2]); return P.map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.name: at the top landing (the roof's height)

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame; N.controller.yaw = F.yaw(-Math.PI / 2); N.controller.pitch = -0.05; return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame; return [[3.0, -1.25], [3.9, -0.9]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('stairs1'), F = s.frame, K = s.live.K; const a = F.v(...([Math.max(s.lb.x0 + 1.0, Math.min(s.lb.x1 - 1.0, 1.6 + 2.4)), s.lot.h + 0.9, -0.2])); const C = N.controller; C.yaw = Math.atan2(-(a.x - G.eye.x), -(a.z - G.eye.z)); C.pitch = -0.4; return 1; })()
